title: VMM 100km Ultra Marathon — 越南文距离页（2024 版）
claims: The Vietnamese 100km page lists the course at 99.5 km with 5,200 m of gain and notes that the 2024 course has some small adjustments.
The Vietnamese page gives a start time of 21:00 on Friday 20-09-2024 from the Sapa park square next to Sapa Square, with a Google Maps link pointing to approximately 22.3356 N, 103.8418 E.
The Vietnamese page gives cut-off times of 04:30 at CP Topas Ecolodge, 12:00 at CP3, 15:00 at CP4, 17:00 at CP5, 20:30 at CP6, 22:00 at CP7 and 23:59 at the finish.
The Vietnamese page allows two drop bags: one to CP Topas Ecolodge and the finish (usable at km 28.6), and one to CP4.
The Vietnamese page badges the 100km as a 4-point ITRA race, an ITRA National League race, a 100K UTMB Index race and a qualifier for Western States 2025.

The Vietnamese course description runs over Ham Rong Mountain to CP6 at Hau Chu Ngai, a new 100km-only trail, CP7 at Su Pan, Mount Silverstone, the Red Dao village of Ban Moi, CP Topas Ecolodge, a water station across a stream, Giang Ta Chai, CP1 at Lao Chai, CP3 at O Quy Ho, Cow Mountain, CP4 at Ta Phin, CP5 at 31 Bridge, Sau Chua and the final Mount Silverstone climb.
The Vietnamese page requires entrants to be at least 18 on race day and to have finished at least one official 50km+ mountain ultra; virtual and club races are not accepted.

verification.note: 该页仍写 2024 届起跑时间与 2024 版距离/爬升，明显落后于英文旧页（2025）与当前英文页；作为英越两版差异的 A 层证据保留。
